title: EXP-067 - Hello World Part 4 Section 8a: Unload, then Show FX_UMsDescription in a Static and Edit on the User-Scope FX_Items Form
objective: Follow hello-world-pt4.md Section 8 steps 1-4 and 8-9 (09:18-11:04), adapted to FX_ names. First refresh the cached metadata with the operator-authorized unload: read the Unload IDO Metadata With Forms User Preference read-only and require it checked; with no runtime Form dirty and any clean FX_Items runtime Form closed, invoke the Web Client Form > Definition > Unload All Global Form Objects exactly once; close the clean FX_Items Designer Form, invoke the Designer Form > Definition > Unload All Global Form Objects exactly once, and reopen the same User-scoped FX_Items Form. Gate: FX_UMsDescription (added to the FX_Items IDO in EXP-066-R2) must be offered by the Designer binding picker; if it is absent, stop blocked before any Form change, without a second unload. Then add a Static named FX_UMsDescriptionStatic with Caption FX_sDescription (existing string "Description") and an Edit named FX_UMsDescriptionEdit with Binding Type Property bound to FX_UMsDescription, placed in the free area right of FX_PictureStatic and below the Unit of Measure field (FX_UMsDescriptionStatic Location 10.5; 42.5 and Size 14; 1.5; FX_UMsDescriptionEdit Location 12.5; 42.5 and Size 14; 1.89). Perform exactly one Designer Save, close and reopen the Designer Form once, and verify both components; then close and reopen the clean runtime FX_Items Form once and verify the description shown for each record (EA -> Each, DZ -> Dozen). The grid column of Section 8 is a later experiment. Findings are observed only.

in_scope: Read AGENTS.md, docs/mongoose/transcripts/hello-world-pt4.md Section 8 (09:18-11:04), the EXP-062-R2 record (the unload sequence and binding gate), the EXP-062-R4 record (Toolbox drop, explicit Layout Size and Location, Caption string behavior) and the EXP-066-R2 record before browser interaction.
Create or update only experiments/EXP-067-hello-world-part-4-section-8a-um-description-static-and-edit.md and evidence/EXP-067/ documentation and evidence files.
Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.
Use the existing authenticated session without reauthentication, refresh, restart or configuration change. List the browser tabs before the first tab selection.

Designer baseline: verify the open Form is exactly FX_Items in User scope for the authenticated operator and clean; record the component list and the Layout Size and Location of FX_UMCombobox, FX_PictureStatic, FX_RefreshButton and the Form; prove FX_UMsDescriptionStatic and FX_UMsDescriptionEdit are absent. If the target area (FX_UMsDescriptionStatic Location 10.5; 42.5 and Size 14; 1.5; FX_UMsDescriptionEdit Location 12.5; 42.5 and Size 14; 1.89) overlaps an existing component or exceeds the Form, stop before any change and report the measurements.

Read-only User Preference gate: open the Web Client User Preferences dialog, record whether Unload IDO Metadata With Forms is checked, and close it with Cancel. If it is not checked, stop blocked before any unload.
Record every open Web Client runtime Form and its dirty state. If any is dirty, stop blocked. Close only a clean FX_Items runtime Form if one is open.
Invoke the Web Client Form > Definition > Unload All Global Form Objects exactly once (re-observe the exact label before the click); record any visible response verbatim.

Close the clean FX_Items Designer Form once (no unsaved-changes prompt), re-observe the Designer Form > Definition label, invoke the Designer Unload All Global Form Objects exactly once with the Form closed, and reopen the same FX_Items User-scoped Form once through the Designer toolbar Open button and Select Form. Re-verify Name, User scope, clean state and the baseline.

Binding gate: through the supported Designer binding picker of a new Edit, confirm FX_UMsDescription is offered. If it is missing or ambiguous, stop before committing anything, record the listed properties and report the blocker; do not unload again.

Add FX_UMsDescriptionStatic: drop one Static from the Toolbox onto the canvas once, rename it FX_UMsDescriptionStatic, set Layout Location 10.5; 42.5 and Size 14; 1.5 explicitly, and set Caption to the existing FX_sDescription string through the Caption dropdown. Record each readback.

Add FX_UMsDescriptionEdit: drop one Edit from the Toolbox once, rename it FX_UMsDescriptionEdit, set Layout Location 12.5; 42.5 and Size 14; 1.89 explicitly, set Data Source Binding Type Property and Binding FX_UMsDescription. Record each readback.
Verify the canvas shows both components in the target area without overlapping others, and that no other component, property or event changed.
Perform exactly one Designer Save through the native toolbar Save and record the native response verbatim.
Close the clean FX_Items Designer Form once and reopen it once through the toolbar Open button; verify both components with their names, geometry, Caption and binding.

Close the clean FX_Items runtime Form once if it is open and reopen it once through Form > Open > Select Form. Select dumbbell, eggs and guitar in turn and record the Unit of Measure and the description shown in FX_UMsDescriptionEdit for each (expected EA Each, DZ Dozen, EA Each). Make no record edits.

Capture screenshots of the baseline, the preference reading, both unload menu labels, the binding picker listing FX_UMsDescription, each component after configuration, the Designer after Save, after the Designer reopen and the runtime with each record.
Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. Classify findings as observed only.
out_of_scope: Any unload, cache or metadata operation other than the two authorized Unload All Global Form Objects invocations (one Web Client runtime, one Designer), including repeating either one; FormSync, deployment or regeneration.
Changing the Unload IDO Metadata With Forms User Preference or any other User Preference.
Closing any runtime Form other than a clean FX_Items runtime Form.
The Section 8 grid column (Edit Grid Columns), and any change to other components, the grid, events, variables or the Form layout.
Creating or changing string resources, IDOs, properties, tables, property classes or themes.
Runtime record changes, runtime Save, imports or exports, and the tutorial step of changing a Unit of Measure.
Check In, Undo Check Out or other checkout-management actions.
Browser JavaScript, console or network inspection, direct URL navigation, refresh or restart.
Modifying earlier experiment records, AGENTS.md, tutorial sources, recipes or files outside the EXP-067 paths.

prohibited_actions: Creating, modifying or deleting any non-FX_ artifact
Starting any other experiment or replay
Modifying production data or disabling security
Never invoke any unload other than exactly one Web Client and exactly one Designer Unload All Global Form Objects, and never repeat either one.
Never invoke the Designer unload while FX_Items is open or dirty in the Designer.
Never change the Unload IDO Metadata With Forms preference or any other User Preference.
Never perform any other cache operation, deployment or FormSync action.
Never change, move or delete an existing component, and never add components other than FX_UMsDescriptionStatic and FX_UMsDescriptionEdit.
Never invoke the Designer Save more than once or retry an uncertain Save.
Never close a dirty Form or discard changes without operator approval.
Never click the Designer top-toolbar Delete button (Delete Form Definition).
Never perform check-in, undo checkout or other checkout-management actions.
Never use direct SQL, scripts, application internals or browser JavaScript.
Never reauthenticate, refresh, restart or replace the browser session.
Never edit runtime records or use runtime Save.
Never claim cross-session durability beyond the observed close/reopen recovery.

acceptance_checks.description: Sources reviewed; session usable; the Designer Form is FX_Items in User scope and clean; the component list and the geometry of FX_UMCombobox, FX_PictureStatic, FX_RefreshButton and the Form recorded; FX_UMsDescriptionStatic and FX_UMsDescriptionEdit absent; the target area free and inside the Form. Evidence: identity, component and geometry screenshots.

Unload gate: Unload IDO Metadata With Forms read as checked and left unchanged; with no dirty runtime Form, exactly one Web Client Unload All Global Form Objects (label recorded); the clean Designer Form closed once and exactly one Designer Unload All Global Form Objects with the Form closed; FX_Items reopened with the same User-scope identity, clean, baseline unchanged; FX_UMsDescription offered by the binding picker. Evidence: preference screenshot, both menu-label screenshots, reopen identity and binding-picker screenshots, unload counts.
FX_UMsDescriptionStatic added once: Static, Location 10.5; 42.5 and Size 14; 1.5, Caption FX_sDescription; readbacks recorded. Evidence: Properties and canvas screenshots.

FX_UMsDescriptionEdit added once: Edit, Location 12.5; 42.5 and Size 14; 1.89, Binding Type Property, Binding FX_UMsDescription; readbacks recorded; no other component changed. Evidence: Properties and canvas screenshots.
Exactly one Designer Save with the native response verbatim; Save disabled afterwards. Evidence: post-Save screenshot and the Save count.
The clean Designer Form closed once and reopened once; both components present with the same names, geometry, Caption and binding. Evidence: reopen screenshots.

The clean runtime FX_Items Form closed once (if open) and reopened once; for dumbbell, eggs and guitar the Unit of Measure and the FX_UMsDescriptionEdit description are recorded (expected EA Each, DZ Dozen, EA Each); no record edits; the Form clean. Evidence: three runtime screenshots.

The final EXP-067 report gives decisive evidence for AC-1 to AC-7, the complete action audit with exact counts (preference read 1 and unchanged, two unloads, one pre-change Designer close/reopen, two Toolbox drops, one Designer Save, one post-Save Designer close/reopen, one runtime close/reopen, zero other component changes, zero record edits), the worker-written-file inventory and the final state. Repository confinement is supported by worker/harness inventories, with operator git review authoritative. Findings are observed only.

initial_instruction: T1 - Read-only preflight for EXP-067. Review AGENTS.md, hello-world-pt4.md Section 8, the EXP-062-R2, EXP-062-R4 and EXP-066-R2 records. Without shell/git access, record the starting state. List the browser tabs before selecting one; identify the Web Client and Web Designer tabs. In the Designer, verify the open Form is FX_Items in User scope and clean, record the component list and the Layout Size and Location of FX_UMCombobox, FX_PictureStatic, FX_RefreshButton and the Form, prove FX_UMsDescriptionStatic and FX_UMsDescriptionEdit absent, and state whether the target area (FX_UMsDescriptionStatic Location 10.5; 42.5 and Size 14; 1.5; FX_UMsDescriptionEdit Location 12.5; 42.5 and Size 14; 1.89) is free and inside the Form. In the Web Client, record the open runtime Forms and their dirty state, and read the Unload IDO Metadata With Forms preference read-only through User Preferences, closing it with Cancel. Create the EXP-067 record with the baseline, preference reading, action audit and worker-written-file inventory, with screenshots under evidence/EXP-067/. notes: Proposed by the operator assistant after EXP-066-R2 (accepted; Part 4 section 7 complete). Section 8 is split: 8a (this brief) unloads and adds the description Static and Edit; 8b (later) adds the grid column through Edit Grid Columns (not yet used by the factory). Operator authorization 2026-10-13 (tenant-wide operation, per AGENTS.md; operator: "yes its fine continue"): exactly one Web Client Unload All Global Form Objects and exactly one Designer Unload All Global Form Objects, each once, never repeated, with the EXP-062-R2 sequence (preference read only; Designer Form closed before the Designer unload). Adaptation: the tutorial places the Static beneath the Unit of Measure field; here FX_PictureStatic occupies that area, so both components go in the free area right of the picture and below FX_UMCombobox (geometry checked in T1; stop if not free). Names follow the EXP-050 convention (FX_<field>Static / Edit). Caption reuses the existing FX_sDescription string ("Description", EXP-050); no string is created. Expected runtime values from EXP-046: EA Each, DZ Dozen. Patterns: the unload-name ban is replaced by guards against other unload commands and preference changes; component deletion, Edit Grid Columns, runtime Import/Export, Check-In, JS, SQL and Delete Form Definition stay banned. exact_values: FX_Items, FX_UMsDescriptionStatic, FX_UMsDescriptionEdit, FX_UMsDescription, FX_sDescription. deny_browser_javascript.
